review_scope: Actual pixel inspection of five final renders (front, front_elevation, top, rear, entry_detail) against five official reference images; not quantitative survey, all 6-view inspection, mesh QA or printing validation.

iteration_history.finding: Initial mixed/in-progress render set showed an unsupported horizontal parapet spur extending inward across roof beside courtyard chamfer, visible in top and entry_detail.
iteration_history.action: Builder identified old preview, shortened horizontal parapet start from nominal x=13 to x=19, and regenerated complete render set.

iteration_history.finding: After BLEND-QA.json appeared, newly viewed top and entry_detail show continuous courtyard parapet without unsupported inward spur.
Parent reviewer identified original front base left/right clipping missed by initial independent visual check; full display base requires margin.
iteration_history.action: Builder enlarged front/front_elevation camera orthographic scale from250 to295 and rerendered both images.

iteration_history.finding: Independently reopened final front and front_elevation. Full visible base silhouette is inside frame; left/right image margins are approximately82px on1200px canvas. Front shows clear top/bottom margin and no protruding roof parapet. Rear base corner is naturally occluded by building, not image clipping.

checks_passed: Plan topology is L-shaped with chamfered re-entrant courtyard corner, consistent with official upper-floor diagram at simplified-outline level.
Three visible storeys; ground-level broad shopfront apertures distinct from two upper levels of slender fins.
No later steel/RC central stair, glass canopy, modern signage or climbing vegetation is represented.
Flat roof and two small end-volume interpretations are present; no neighbouring pitched tiled roof was mistakenly attached.
Reviewed renders show no conspicuous clipping, detached facade components or camera obstruction after correction.
README explicitly identifies estimated nominal dimensions, non-current historical scope, opaque glazing, guessed stairhead sizes, unknown rear elevation detail and lack of trial print.

Final front and front_elevation display base visible extents are fully within frame, with substantial margin; no crop at left/right/top/bottom. Close-up entry_detail intentionally crops surrounding building.
limitations: This passes only as an explicitly approximate 1981-1986 exterior interpretation, not a precise restoration.
Unseen rear facades remain blank placeholders, not evidence of original blind walls. Retain this caveat alongside images.
Fin count, window/door position and proportions, exact floor heights, roof parapet size, stairhead height and colours are not independently measurable from supplied low-resolution images.
Floor-plan outlines may include slabs/eaves. Model uses one simplified shell rather than asserting precise per-storey wall footprint.
No interiors, underground basement, real terrain, roof services or trial print are validated.
